overview_description.description: Benepass is a benefits administration platform that helps companies manage and distribute employee perks and benefits. Through deep investments into the company's financial technology infrastructure, Benepass has made it easy for employers to offer global benefits that are personalized to every employee. The Benepass platform offers employees four different ways to spend their benefit dollars globally: card, mobile wallet, reimbursements, and a marketplace.

about_short_description.short_description: Benepass is a benefits administration platform that helps companies manage and distribute employee perks and benefits.

product.name: Benepass Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA)
product.description: A flexible spending account allowing employees to use pre-tax funds for various personal expenses like student loans, childcare, and eldercare.

product.name: Benepass Commuter Benefits
product.description: A program that simplifies commuter benefits by allowing employees to use pre-tax funds for various commuting options via a Benepass card.

identifier.value: Benepass Family Care and Formation Account

product.name: Benepass Family Care and Formation Account
product.description: A benefits account supporting various family-related expenses such as childcare, eldercare, fertility, and adoption services.

product.name: Benepass Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
product.description: A modernized FSA platform for health and dependent care expenses with automated enrollment and easy employee access via physical and virtual cards.

product.name: Benepass Health Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA)
product.description: A card-based HRA solution allowing employees to pay for eligible healthcare expenses with employer-funded, tax-free dollars tailored to individual needs.

product.name: Benepass Professional Development Account
product.description: A benefits account that funds employee professional growth activities like courses, coaching, certifications, and conferences.
